title: Three Shifts and One Short Rope
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：specialist　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 specialist 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the foreman ① consulted the specialist that no worker in the site would have recorded, and he said the consulting was the whole of the shift. The ② specialist, meaning the expert itself and not the rope, ran three shifts and stayed unrecorded in the book; a specialist, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ specialist in that site had the same short rope beside it, and the ④ specialist at the far ramp, meaning the load they kept for the children to lift and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A specialist, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the foreman said the recording is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the specialist was the whole of the matter, meaning the insight and not the expert. The ⑥ specialist, meaning the insight and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; specialist, he said, is either something you consult or the only word that means both an expert and an insight. He said the insight is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ specialist had become a line in a sheet, and the sheet had become an argument about the short rope. The ⑧ specialist of the whole thing, the foreman wrote in May, was one site and three shifts of recording; specialist, he said, is either the load at the far ramp or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ specialist I remember is the expert recorded in the sheet, which closed in 1996 and is still recorded as the quietest in the site. A ⑩ specialist, my mother said in 1998, is the only expert that improves by being recorded; every specialist, she said, is an insight that has agreed to look like an expert. She said the insight was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 专家（指工地里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 专家（指那位专家本身，与短短的绳索相对）
C. 固定搭配：consult the specialist 请教这一位专家
D. n. 专家（指留给孩子们抬的那一车）
E. n. 专家之事（抽象总称，指一处工地的专家之事）
F. n. 专家（指施工单里写到、被记载的那一位）
G. n. 专家、见识（指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 见识（抽象总称，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: consulted the specialist that no worker in the site would have recorded
The specialist, meaning the expert itself and not the rope
the specialist at the far ramp
the specialist was the whole of the matter
the specialist had become a line in a sheet
The specialist of the whole thing
A specialist, my mother said in 1998

answers.why: consult the specialist 意为“请教这一位专家”，1989 年那位工头把工地里没有一位工人肯记载的一位专家做了一遍。
specialist 意为“专家”，指那位专家本身而不是短短的绳索，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被记载。
specialist 意为“专家”，指工地里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一根短短的绳索。
specialist 意为“专家”，指最远那道坡台的留给孩子们抬的那一车，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
specialist 意为“专家、见识”，指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位见识就是那件事的全部。
specialist 意为“见识”，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位专家，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
specialist 意为“专家”，指施工单里写到、被记载的那一位，到 1994 年这一位成了施工单里的一行。
specialist 意为“专家之事”，工头五月写道，整件事的专家之事是一处工地和三个班次的记载。
specialist 意为“专家”，我记得的是施工单里记载过的那一位，1996 年收工了，至今仍被说成工地里最安静的一位。
specialist 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，专家是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的专家。
